name: An application's records say only what is its own
principle: An application's records describe what only the application has, and a reader sees at once which jobs it borrows from a library and which it defines.
state_description: A job a library defines has one definition, the library's, and the application's records point to it. The application's own records hold its own needs in full, with their metrics, customization and code. A solution that proves general lives in the library from then on, and the application points to it.
hints_of_measurement: Share of an application's solution records that restate a library solution; share of references that resolve; whether a reader can name, for each solution, whether it is adopted, specialized or the application's own.
